scope: All 26 registered app pages, contextual management controls and shared dialogs

patterns: Focus, hover and tap; Escape and outside dismissal
Viewport-bounded tooltip; delayed hover dismissal allows pointer entry
semantics: No nested buttons or buttons inside navigation links

shared: Positive decimal amounts for Trade, Supply, Vault and LP controls
Native min/max, pattern and number constraints
Optional Guardrails percentages and quote age
Public Stellar account shape; checksum/ledger verification remains unavailable
feedback: Errors do not enable unavailable financial review

states: Stale with refresh action and blocked review
recovery.drafts: Editable values stay in memory, scoped to the full route/context. Password, file, hidden, readonly and disabled controls are excluded. Retry restores inputs and invalidates old comparisons/quotes; no plan, signature or receipt is recreated.
recovery.sourceFailure: Liquidity source failure has retry and opportunity navigation; asynchronous render retains preview warnings.
recovery.boundary: Synchronous renderer/binder failures show recovery rather than a blank workspace. Real request IDs and source errors must come from the backend; none are invented.
